newsitem.title: UK: LEP has new global strategic marketing director.
newsitem.headline: LEP has new global strategic marketing director.

text.p: LEP International Worldwide(LIW) said Jonathan Himoff has joined LIW as global strategic marketing director.
The company said in a statement that he has already taken up his position and will report to chief executive officer,Jack Wasp.

Himoff will focus on developing the marketing programme for LEP's IT System , Fast400 and expanding LEP's Lotus Notes Global Account database. He will be working on the development and control of LEP's expanding, Global Account programme.
Himoff was previously account development director with the Fritz Companies. --Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax:5017
